question: What signed non-memo itemized disbursements appear on reviewed regular committee form lines in one processed Schedule B snapshot, with other reporting scopes and unresolved records kept separate?

inputs.role: Complete lossless selected-cycle Schedule B columnar facts
inputs.version_policy: Pin exact fact manifest, source artifact, physical schema, and every backing shard digest.

identity.result_key: Cycle + exact input + policy version, then filer, form, line, schedule, reporting role, decision, and recipient evidence state
identity.input_manifest: Exact immutable fact-set identity and manifest SHA-256; no mutable pointer reread
identity.result_digest: Deterministic calculation_set_id and groups_sha256; execution time is not part of the output

ordered_steps: Validate physical schema, exact source ordinals, cycle, and memo/amount normalization. Fail the whole calculation on inconsistent typed data.
Classify reporting scope and role using exact form, line, and SB schedule; do not reinterpret labels, names, or purpose text.
Assign one decision in order: memo X; missing amount; unreviewed schedule; unreviewed form-line; distinct reporting scope; invalid regular-filer ID; included regular non-memo itemized disbursement.
Keep F4 convention, F9 F93 electioneering notice, reviewed Levin lines, and F3X line 24 reported on SB separate from the regular-committee subtotal.
Preserve negative and zero amounts, all action codes, and repeated transaction references without local amendment selection or deduplication.
Group by the exact policy key, preserving NULL versus empty text. Record recipient identity agreement, self references, and name presence without converting them into flow or ownership.
Conserve every source row and signed cent independently across all result groups and decision buckets; emit deterministic JSON only on success.

decision_states.meaning: Reviewed regular-committee form-line non-memo itemized amount; not total spending or cash flow.
Memo-X evidence retained outside the non-memo subtotal.
Convention, electioneering notice, Levin, or IE-on-SB evidence retained separately.
Missing amount, invalid regular-filer ID, or unreviewed reporting shape retained explicitly.

invariants: Every fact remains in its immutable Parquet source; calculated groups do not replace or collapse source evidence.
No Schedule B reporting result is graph-eligible.
A federal-contribution line can describe own contributions, forwarded earmarks, or in-kind activity; neither names nor absent type codes distinguish these automatically.
A raw or cleaned recipient ID may identify a beneficiary rather than the named cash payee.

output.grain: One deterministic cycle calculation containing disjoint filer/reporting/evidence groups and exact totals

publication_states.meaning: Complete reporting calculation with no unresolved rows; no claim of complete economic flows.
Complete source conservation with explicit unresolved reporting rows.

revisions.input_change_policy: A different source fact identity recomputes that cycle.
revisions.method_change_policy: Change the policy version for any membership, role, scope, identity-state, grouping, or arithmetic change.
revisions.history_policy: Retain source facts and prior calculation artifacts. No active pointer or automated publisher is implemented in this command.

checks.rule: Verify immutable input, every shard digest, full physical schema, source ordinals, and cycle.
Reject inconsistent typed memo or amount fields.
Group and decision totals equal the independently scanned source rows, known signed cents, missing amounts, and sign counts.
Unreviewed reporting rows remain unresolved, never remapped from text.

scenarios: Unknown, absent, empty, and case-variant lines

propagation.no_change_policy: The same exact input and policy produce byte-identical result JSON across worker counts. Persistent reuse and Dagster publication remain deferred.

use.retention: Retain calculated results and underlying fact sets; do not write dense duplicate fact records.
use.disclaimer: These are processed reporting subtotals, not total committee spending, cash-only payments, economic-flow ownership, or money personally received by a politician.
